confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, cappuccino and draught-beer anchors triangulate several Gothenburg cost-of-living sources seen only as search snippets (crowd-sourced, partly undated); beer assumes a 0.5 L domestic draught. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker, based on city bar-price bands and sanity-checked against typical beer ratios. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. SEK prices were converted to USD at an approximate general-knowledge rate, not a live quote, so expect a few percent of FX error.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food and drink, which rest on Gothenburg-specific aggregates. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Gothenburg's hotel and hostel market, placed somewhat below Stockholm-level pricing.
